faq: Can you promise page one on Google?

No one honestly can. We fix what is in your control: clear titles, descriptions, redirects and structure, and we explain each change. Rankings depend on competition, content and time, so we do not promise positions.
Do you need access to Google Search Console?

Will changing titles hurt my current rankings?
We keep pages that already perform and change only titles that are missing, duplicated or unclear. When we change a page address, we add a redirect so the old link still leads to the right place.
Do you write blog posts too?
Not in this service. It covers page level upkeep for products, collections and pages. Content writing is a separate service, and we can quote it if you want help with a blog.
desc:
Shopify SEO upkeep and redirects keeps the basics that search engines read in good order: page titles, meta descriptions, alt text, headings and links. Ecom Swift LLC fixes these in your admin and records every change in a sheet.

## What is Shopify SEO upkeep?

Shopify SEO upkeep is the regular tidying of the technical and written details that tell search engines what each page is about. It includes titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, heading order, sitemap checks and redirects for pages that were deleted or renamed.

It is different from a big content or link-building campaign. Upkeep is about making sure every page is correct, clear and findable, so nothing you already have goes to waste.

## Why small SEO errors add up

Stores change constantly. Products are added, collections renamed and old pages deleted. Each change can leave a gap: a product with no description for search, two pages with the same title, or a link that now leads to an error page.

When a page that people have linked to or bookmarked disappears, visitors land on a 404 and leave. Search engines notice the same dead end. Duplicate or missing titles make it harder for Google to tell your pages apart. None of these problems is dramatic alone, but together they weaken the store.

## How clean pages help visibility

A clear title and description tells searchers what they will find before they click. A page that matches the question is more likely to be chosen. Alt text describes images to people who use screen readers and gives search engines context for the picture. Sensible heading order makes a page easier to read and to understand.

Redirects keep the value of old addresses. When a product or collection moves, a redirect sends visitors and search engines to the right new page. A correct sitemap and a connected Google Search Console help Google find and report on your pages. Rankings depend on many factors, including competition and content, so we aim for correct, clean pages and do not promise a position.

## What good SEO upkeep includes

- Unique page titles for products, collections and key pages.
- Meta descriptions written for people, with the main phrase used naturally.
- Alt text for images on important pages.
- A check for duplicate and missing titles and descriptions.
- Heading order reviewed, so each page has one clear main heading.
- Broken links and 404 pages found and redirected to a fitting page.
- A sitemap check and a review of the robots file.
- Google Search Console connected and checked for errors.
- Collection page text reviewed for clarity.
- A change sheet with old and new text, and a to-do list for the next month.

## What we do

We start with a crawl of your store and a look at what Google Search Console reports, if it is connected. We list the pages with missing, duplicate or unclear text, and the links that lead nowhere.

Then we write and enter the new titles and descriptions directly in your Shopify admin, writing for people first. Every change goes into the change sheet, so you can see the old and new versions side by side. Standard adds redirects, the sitemap check and a Search Console setup check. Premium covers a larger set of pages and images, reviews headings and collection text, and ends with a to-do list for next month. We do not write blog posts as part of this package.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us the phrases customers use when they look for your products.
- Keep one main topic for each page.
- Redirect any page that you delete or rename.
- Write titles that read naturally, with the key phrase near the start.
- Keep the change sheet as a record.

**Avoid:**
- Stuffing titles with repeated keywords.
- Copying the same description onto many products.
- Deleting old pages without a redirect.
- Changing every title at once with no record of the old text.
- Expecting changes to show in search results the same day.

## Who this is for

This service suits store owners who have never touched their search titles, and stores that were redesigned or restructured and now have broken links. It also suits sellers who add products regularly and want their pages kept in order, and anyone who wants a clean base before paying for content or advertising.

## What we need from you

We need a staff or collaborator invitation to your store, and, if you use it, access to Google Search Console as a user with permission to view reports. We never need your password. Share your main product groups and the phrases you want to be found for. We will confirm the scope in writing, then send the change sheet when the work is complete.
